e.title: 链上参数化风暴保险：两份独立信号必须同时认定严重度达标才放款，任何一份单独成立都不够；并且它把「解析不到字段」这一类失败称为「一个自动化系统出错的最安静的方式」
e.title_en: On-chain parametric storm insurance where two independent signals must both find the severity above threshold — neither alone is enough — and where failing to parse a field is described as the quietest possible way for an automated system to be wrong
e.title_hk: 鏈上參數化風暴保險：兩份獨立信號必須同時認定嚴重度達標才放款，任何一份單獨成立都不夠；並且它把「解析不到字段」這一類失敗稱為「一個自動化系統出錯的最安靜的方式」
e.summary: 一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的参数化风暴保险协议：它交叉印证两份真实、实时的意图信号，套用一个既做置信度校准又绑定地理位置的阈值，然后无人干预地自动执行一笔有上限的链上赔付，并把握手双方信号哈希、双方置信度与一段可读理由一起写进链上事件，使决定可在区块浏览器上核对而不只是被断言；两份信号必须各自独立地认定严重度超过阈值，任何一份单独成立都不够；其置信度校准规则来自该项目自己上一轮的教训——一个候选在严格的离线对抗测试里得了满分，却在真实评测器上只过 7/15，因此它不再信任任何单一的自报数字；其位置绑定检查在雅加达的真实测试中抓到过一份「严重度对、地点错」的信号并当场拒绝放款；它另做了一次可复现的兼容性实测：24 次路由调用、12 个地点、总花费 0.24 美元、零失败，结论是「按文档字段名写的读取器」在两个意图上都是 0/12 能取到严重度，而形态无关的适配器是 12/12；它对这一差距的表述是：一个按某个矿工字段名写的集成在路由换人之后仍会返回 HTTP 200，只是再也找不到它要的字段，而对一个按阈值行动的消费者来说，那读起来像是「情况从不严重」而不是一次失败
e.summary_hk: 一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的參數化風暴保險協議：它交叉印證兩份真實、實時的意圖信號，套用一個既做置信度校準又綁定地理位置的閾值，然後無人干預地自動執行一筆有上限的鏈上賠付，並把握手雙方信號哈希、雙方置信度與一段可讀理由一起寫進鏈上事件，使決定可在區塊瀏覽器上核對而不只是被斷言；兩份信號必須各自獨立地認定嚴重度超過閾值，任何一份單獨成立都不夠；其置信度校準規則來自該項目自己上一輪的教訓——一個候選在嚴格的離線對抗測試裡得了滿分，卻在真實評測器上只過 7/15，因此它不再信任任何單一的自報數字；其位置綁定檢查在雅加達的真實測試中抓到過一份「嚴重度對、地點錯」的信號並當場拒絕放款；它另做了一次可復現的兼容性實測：24 次路由調用、12 個地點、總花費 0.24 美元、零失敗，結論是「按文檔字段名寫的讀取器」在兩個意圖上都是 0/12 能取到嚴重度，而形態無關的適配器是 12/12；它對這一差距的表述是：一個按某個礦工字段名寫的集成在路由換人之後仍會返回 HTTP 200，只是再也找不到它要的字段，而對一個按閾值行動的消費者來說，那讀起來像是「情況從不嚴重」而不是一次失敗
e.summary_en: A parametric storm insurance protocol built on Telegraph Protocol: it cross-corroborates two real, live intent signals, applies a threshold that is both confidence-calibrated and bound to a location, then autonomously executes a bounded on-chain payout with no human in the loop, attaching both signal hashes, both confidence values and a human-readable reason to the on-chain event so the decision can be audited on a block explorer rather than merely asserted; the two signals must each independently find the severity above threshold, and neither alone is enough; its confidence rule comes from the project’s own prior lesson, where a candidate scored full marks on a rigorous offline adversarial test yet passed only 7 of 15 live against the real evaluator, so it no longer trusts any single self-reported number; its location-binding check caught a right-severity, wrong-place signal live during real testing against Jakarta and correctly held instead of releasing a payout; it also ran a reproducible compatibility measurement — 24 routed calls, 12 locations, $0.24 total, zero failures — finding that a reader written against the documented field names could derive severity in 0 of 12 cases for both intents while a shape-agnostic adapter managed 12 of 12; and it describes that gap by noting that an integration written against one miner’s field names keeps returning HTTP 200 after the router moves on while simply no longer finding its fields, which for a consumer acting on thresholds reads as conditions never being severe rather than as a failure
e.body:
**storm-parametric-corroboration**（StormPolicy，仓库 `egbujor-emmanuel/telegraph-stormpolicy`）**是一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**参数化风暴保险协议****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 229 KB、创建于 2026-09-01、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**⚠️ 其许可字段实测为 NONE，**且本次已在 59 个条目中确认**不存在名为 `LICENSE` 的文件**（**属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态**——**见标注 ①**）、**无 topics**；**README 实测 17,264 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 59 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「A parametric storm-insurance protocol built on Telegraph Protocol for the Track 3 (Applications) hackathon track. It **cross-corroborates two real, live Telegraph intents**, applies a **confidence-calibrated and location-bound threshold**, and **autonomously executes a bounded on-chain payout** — with no human in the loop and **the full evidence trail stored on-chain**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「单方面不成立」**中的**第三种，也是四条里把这条原则表述得最锋利的一条**——**它有一句可以被反复引用的判词（见第④点）**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其决策链的第三步就是本轮主题本身，且措辞不留余地**——**逐字为**：**「It **cross-corroborates**: **both signals must independently indicate severity above threshold. Neither one alone is enough.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**两份信号各自独立地认定严重度超过阈值，任何一份单独成立都不够****——**⚠️ 而**两份信号是同一家网络的两类意图**（`WEATHER_FORECAST` 与 `STORM_ALERT`）**，**故本词条**不主张**这是**统计意义上的独立来源**，**只记录它要求两者同时成立**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第四步把「置信度」与「正确性」分开，并给出了这个教训的**来处与具体数字****——**逐字为**：**「It **calibrates confidence**, not just severity: **a forecast miner reporting low confidence in its own data holds the decision regardless of how severe the numbers look.** This is a **direct, deliberate lesson from this project’s own Track 2 WASM-scoring work, where a candidate scored 100% on a rigorous offline adversarial test yet only 7/15 live against the real evaluator** — **stated confidence and real correctness are not the same thing**, and this project does not repeat that mistake by trusting a single self-reported number.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处都值得单独记**：**① **一条**来自自己上一轮失败的规则****——**「离线对抗测试满分、真实评测器 7/15」**是一个**很具体、很难得**的数字**（**多数项目不会把自己的这个数字写出来**）；**② **由它推出的规则是**「不再信任任何单一的自报数字」****——**⭐ 这与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「校准斜率带事先声明的治理带 [0.85, 1.15]」、第 335 轮「宁可拒绝，也不假装」共同构成同一条线**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第五步的现场拦截是本条最有说服力的一处证据，因为它是一次**未被编排的**真实测试**——**逐字为**：**「It **binds signals to the policy’s location**, not just to a severity number. **During real testing (not staged) against Jakarta, Indonesia — a location never touched before — the STORM_ALERT miner returned a signal scoped to "South China Sea" rather than Jakarta itself. The entity-binding check caught this live and correctly held instead of releasing a payout on a right-severity, wrong-place signal.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「严重度对、地点错」是一类很典型的**看起来很正常的错误****：**数字在阈值之上、调用成功、字段齐全**，**唯一不对的是**那件事不在这里发生****——**⭐ 而作者写明这是**真实测试（not staged）**且**该地点此前从未被触碰**（**故不是自己挑出来的样本**）**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该次测试的记录**（**见标注 ⑤**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对「解析不到字段」的判词是本轮四条候选里最锋利的一句，也是本词条认为最值得记住的一段**——**逐字为**：**「Which miner answers is a ranking decision, and ranking is exactly what the flywheel is supposed to change. So the schema an application receives is **a property of the network at call time, not a fixed contract**. **An integration written against one miner’s field names keeps returning HTTP 200 after the router moves on — it simply stops finding the fields it was looking for.** For a consumer that acts on thresholds, **that reads as "conditions are never severe" rather than as a failure, which is the quietest possible way for an automated system to be wrong.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一个自动化系统出错的最安静的方式」**——**本词条认为这句话值得被单独引用**：**它指出的失败**没有异常、没有非 200 响应、没有超时**，**只是**阈值条件永远不成立****；**而**在自动放款的场景里，「从不触发」与「正确地永不触发」在监控上**长得一模一样****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该风险只存在于本协议**——**相反，它适用于任何按外部字段阈值行动的自动化**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其兼容性实测（本条的第二个机制）是一份**可复现的小型研究**，不是一段印象**——**方法逐字为**：**「`study-miner-shapes.mjs` makes real, x402-paid, auto-routed calls for both intents across **12 locations on five continents**, recording which miner the router selected, the response shape, and whether two different consumers can derive what they need — a **canonical-field reader** … versus this project’s **shape-agnostic adapter**.」**；**结果逐字为**：**「**24 routed calls, 12 locations, $0.24 total, zero failures, median latency 2.0s**」**——**`WEATHER_FORECAST` 严重度可导出：**按文档字段名的读取器 0/12（0%）**，**形态无关适配器 12/12（100%）**；**`STORM_ALERT` 同样 0/12 对 12/12**；**信号绑定到所请求地点 24/24（100%）****；**并逐字说明差距为何这么大**：**「Two miners, the same intent, and **exactly one field name in common** (`confidence`). One returns hourly and daily series in millimetres and metres per second; the other returns **prose with the numbers inside it**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **「两个矿工、同一意图、**恰好只有一个字段名相同**」**——**这是一条很有冲击力的实测结论**；**② **一个把预报放在**英文句子**里返回**；**③ **另一个完全没有单一风险分数**（**「reporting `level`, `breach`, `official_alerts` and raw measurements **with no single risk score at all**」**）**——**⭐ 即**「严重度」这个概念在同一个意图下**并不是一个字段，而是一件需要适配的事****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其适配器的四条规则逐字，其中一条对本行尤其相关**——**逐字为**：**「severity is derived from whichever representation is present — probability, millimetres, an m/s series, declared risk flags, official alerts, a threshold breach, or prose」**；**「**an explicit numeric reading is never inflated by that same miner’s coarser label, so a precise `0.57` cannot be rounded up into a payout by the word next to it**」**；**「when nothing usable is present **the signal is `null` and the decision holds** — **it fails closed, never open**」**；**「readings parsed from prose are recorded as **prose-derived**, so **weaker evidence is visible in the on-chain reason instead of silently ranking equal to structured fields**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四条各拒绝一件事**：**① 从**任何一种**表示法中导出严重度**（**概率、毫米、米每秒序列、声明的风险标记、官方警报、阈值突破、或散文**）；**② **明确数字不得被同一个矿工更粗的标签抬高**——**「一个精确的 0.57 不能被它旁边的那个词抬成一次赔付」****（**⭐ 对做定价与规则引擎的同学，这是「不要让一个粗糙的定性标签改写一个定量读数」的最小表述**）；**③ **取不到就置 `null` 并让决定保持不放款**——**「**it fails closed, never open**」**；**④ **从散文里解析出来的读数被标记为**散文来源**，使**较弱的证据在链上理由里可见，而不是悄悄与结构化字段同级****（**⭐ 第 ④ 条与前两条共同构成一件很少见的事：**证据强度本身被记录下来了**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其测试与链条逐字**：**「**[79 conformance tests](test-regressions.mjs) pin these guarantees **against captured live responses from every miner shape above, and run in CI on every push**.」**⭐⭐ **即**79 个一致性测试锁住上述保证，且用的是**从各种矿工形态抓下来的真实响应**，并在每次推送时于 CI 运行**（**实测 `test-regressions.mjs` 存在**；**⚠️ 本词条**未读其内容、未运行**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「是什么、不是什么」一节把边界划得很清楚，并给出了一句排序判断**——**逐字为**：**「It is **not pooled insurance**. **There is no premium, no capital pool and no underwriting**: whoever wants cover funds the entire payout themselves, which makes this **conditional settlement rather than risk transfer**. **Pricing a premium means modelling how likely the event is, which is a different problem from establishing whether it occurred** — and it is the second one this project set out to solve. **The verification layer is the part that has to be trustworthy first; a pool built on a settlement rail nobody trusts would be worth nothing.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **它不是集合保险**（无保费、无资金池、无核保），**而应称为**附条件的结算**；**② **它把「定价」与「认定事件是否发生」明确分成两个问题**，并声明只做第二个**（**⭐ 对精算读者，这是一个很干净的边界声明**）；**③ **「先得让认定层可信」的排序判断**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其对调度现实的自陈也很少见**——**逐字为**：**「a GitHub Actions job is scheduled every 15 minutes … **In practice GitHub’s cron scheduler is best-effort, not to-the-minute: observed cadence on this repo has been every 2–5 hours rather than every 15 minutes.** The job itself is correct and does trigger real payouts when it runs (verified: [`f94f0cb`](...) …) — **the gap is GitHub’s scheduler, not the logic**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它把一个「看起来没按时跑」的现象**归因到了平台**，**并给出一个链上交易作为**真的触发过**的证据**（**⭐ 对做定时任务的同学，这是**「区分我的代码没跑」与「平台没按时叫我」**的一个样本**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **合约层逐字，且证据被写进合约调用**：**「A single authorized agent address can trigger a policy’s payout exactly once, and **must attach the full evidence — both signal hashes, both confidence values, a human-readable reason — as part of that call, so the decision is auditable on a block explorer, not just asserted**.」**⭐⭐ **即**赔付只能由单一授权地址触发一次、且**必须随调用附上全部证据****——**⭐ 「可核对而不只是被断言」与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「报价须由服务端按输入与规则版本重算」是同一诉求的两种落点**。**⑪ ⭐ **实测仓库结构**：**`contracts/StormPolicy.sol` 与 `contracts/StormPolicyBonded.sol`、`build/` 下四个构建产物（两个 ABI JSON 与两个 bytecode 文本）、`src/decision-engine.mjs`、`study-miner-shapes.mjs`、`study-miner-comparison.mjs`、`study-miner-comparison.json`、`test-regressions.mjs`、`mcp/server.mjs`、`.github/workflows/monitor.yml`、`package.json`**⭐⭐ **⭐ 其中三处值得注意**：**① **实测存在**第二个合约 `StormPolicyBonded.sol`**，**而本次所读的 README 章节只描述了 `StormPolicy.sol`**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**两者的差异**——**未读任何一份合约源码**）；**② **实测存在一份**实测结果数据文件** `study-miner-comparison.json`**（**与第⑤点的研究对应**）；**③ **同一管道另以 MCP 服务器形式暴露**（**`mcp/server.mjs`**），**使**智能体可以不经表单直接建单与查单****。**⑫ ⭐ 可与本站参数化险、巨灾与智能体评测条目并读**：[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[catrisk-sim]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[floodwise]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[agentbench]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可情形如实记录，并指出一处需要读者自己核对的细节****：**GitHub 许可字段实测为 **NONE****；**⚠️ 本次已在 59 个条目中确认**不存在名为 `LICENSE` 的文件**——**故**属本站记录的「**完全未声明**」形态**（**即不是「声称许可而无文件」，而是**完全没有许可声明****）；**⚠️ 本词条据此提示：**在复制、修改或再分发其合约、适配器或评测脚本前应先向作者确认授权****（**⚠️ 对做链上项目的同学，这一条尤其相关**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未读任何源码**——**包括 `contracts/StormPolicy.sol`、`src/decision-engine.mjs`、`study-miner-shapes.mjs`、`test-regressions.mjs` 与 `mcp/server.mjs`**；**故**本词条所述的交互相关、置信度校准、位置绑定、四条件适配器规则、79 个一致性测试与链上证据封装，**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****——**⚠️ **⚠️ 本词条**已实测的只是这些机制各自对应的**文件确实存在****（**`contracts/` 下两个 `.sol`、`src/decision-engine.mjs`、`study-miner-shapes.mjs`、`study-miner-comparison.mjs` 与其结果 JSON、`test-regressions.mjs`、`mcp/server.mjs`、`.github/workflows/monitor.yml`**），**但文件存在不等于其中的逻辑如文档所述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何实测数字与结论**——**包括 24 次路由调用／12 个地点／0.24 美元／零失败／2.0 秒中位延迟、两个意图上 0/12 对 12/12、地点绑定 24/24、以及「两个矿工恰好只有一个字段名相同」**；**⚠️ 本次**未运行 `npm run study:report`、未读 `study-miner-comparison.json`、未做任何网络调用****。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未做任何链上核实**——**⚠️ 本次**未访问 Base Sepolia、未查其合约地址、未读任何交易、未核实其赔付确实发生过、未核实其证据确实随调用来写****；**⭐ 尤其**未核实 README 所引的那笔交易**——**本词条据此**不主张**该协议已在任何网络上真实运行或已执行过任何赔付**。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**雅加达那次现场拦截的记录**——**即**未查其 issue、提交、日志或任何留痕**；**⚠️ 本词条只记录 README **storm-parametric-corroboration**（StormPolicy，倉庫 `egbujor-emmanuel/telegraph-stormpolicy`）**是一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**參數化風暴保險協議****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 JavaScript、體量 229 KB、創建於 2026-09-01、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**⚠️ 其許可字段實測為 NONE**（**見標注 ①**）、**無 topics**；**README 實測 17,264 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 59 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「A parametric storm-insurance protocol built on Telegraph Protocol for the Track 3 (Applications) hackathon track. It **cross-corroborates two real, live Telegraph intents**, applies a **confidence-calibrated and location-bound threshold**, and **autonomously executes a bounded on-chain payout** — with no human in the loop and **the full evidence trail stored on-chain**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「單方面不成立」**中的**第三種，也是四條裡把這條原則表述得最鋒利的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其決策鏈的第三步就是本輪主題本身，且措辭不留餘地**——**逐字為**：**「It **cross-corroborates**: **both signals must independently indicate severity above threshold. Neither one alone is enough.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**兩份信號各自獨立地認定嚴重度超過閾值，任何一份單獨成立都不夠****——**⚠️ 而**兩份信號是同一家網絡的兩類意圖**（`WEATHER_FORECAST` 與 `STORM_ALERT`），**故本詞條**不主張**這是**統計意義上的獨立來源**，**只記錄它要求兩者同時成立**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第四步把「置信度」與「正確性」分開，並給出了這個教訓的**來處與具體數字****——**逐字**：**「It **calibrates confidence**, not just severity: **a forecast miner reporting low confidence in its own data holds the decision regardless of how severe the numbers look.** This is a **direct, deliberate lesson from this project’s own Track 2 WASM-scoring work, where a candidate scored 100% on a rigorous offline adversarial test yet only 7/15 live against the real evaluator** — **stated confidence and real correctness are not the same thing**, and this project does not repeat that mistake by trusting a single self-reported number.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處都值得單獨記**：**① **一條**來自自己上一輪失敗的規則****（**「離線對抗測試滿分、真實評測器 7/15」是一個很具體、很難得的數字**）；**② **由它推出的規則是**「不再信任任何單一的自報數字」****——**⭐ 這與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「校準斜率帶事先聲明的治理帶 [0.85, 1.15]」、第 335 輪「寧可拒絕，也不假裝」共同構成同一條線**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第五步的現場攔截是最有說服力的一處證據，因為它是一次**未被編排的**真實測試****——**逐字**：**「It **binds signals to the policy’s location**, not just to a severity number. **During real testing (not staged) against Jakarta, Indonesia — a location never touched before — the STORM_ALERT miner returned a signal scoped to "South China Sea" rather than Jakarta itself. The entity-binding check caught this live and correctly held instead of releasing a payout on a right-severity, wrong-place signal.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「嚴重度對、地點錯」是一類很典型的**看起來很正常的錯誤****：**數字在閾值之上、調用成功、字段齊全**，**唯一不對的是**那件事不在這裡發生****——**⭐ 而作者寫明這是**真實測試（not staged）**且**該地點此前從未被觸碰****；**⚠️ 未核實**該次測試的記錄**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其對「解析不到字段」的判詞是本輪四條候選裡最鋒利的一句**——**逐字**：**「Which miner answers is a ranking decision, and ranking is exactly what the flywheel is supposed to change. So the schema an application receives is **a property of the network at call time, not a fixed contract**. **An integration written against one miner’s field names keeps returning HTTP 200 after the router moves on — it simply stops finding the fields it was looking for.** For a consumer that acts on thresholds, **that reads as "conditions are never severe" rather than as a failure, which is the quietest possible way for an automated system to be wrong.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一個自動化系統出錯的最安靜的方式」值得被單獨引用**：**它指出的失敗**沒有異常、沒有非 200 響應、沒有超時**，**只是**閾值條件永遠不成立****；**而**在自動放款的場景裡，「從不觸發」與「正確地永不觸發」在監控上**長得一模一樣****（**⚠️ 不主張**該風險只存在於本協議——**相反，它適用於任何按外部字段閾值行動的自動化**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其兼容性實測是一份**可復現的小型研究**，不是一段印象**——**方法逐字**：**「`study-miner-shapes.mjs` makes real, x402-paid, auto-routed calls for both intents across **12 locations on five continents** … two different consumers … a **canonical-field reader** … versus this project’s **shape-agnostic adapter**.」**；**結果逐字**：**「**24 routed calls, 12 locations, $0.24 total, zero failures, median latency 2.0s**」**——**`WEATHER_FORECAST` 嚴重度可導出：**按文檔字段名的讀取器 0/12（0%）**，**形態無關適配器 12/12（100%）**；**`STORM_ALERT` 同樣 0/12 對 12/12**；**信號綁定到所請求地點 24/24（100%）****；**並逐字說明差距為何這麼大**：**「Two miners, the same intent, and **exactly one field name in common** (`confidence`). One returns hourly and daily series in millimetres and metres per second; the other returns **prose with the numbers inside it**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **「兩個礦工、同一意圖、**恰好只有一個字段名相同**」**；**② **一個把預報放在**英文句子**裡返回**；**③ **另一個完全沒有單一風險分數**（**`level`、`breach`、`official_alerts` 加原始測量值，**with no single risk score at all**）**——**⭐ 即**「嚴重度」這個概念在同一個意圖下**並不是一個字段，而是一件需要適配的事****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其適配器的四條規則逐字，其中一條對本行尤其相關**：**從**任何一種**表示法導出嚴重度（**概率、毫米、米每秒序列、聲明的風險標記、官方警報、閾值突破、或散文**）；**「**an explicit numeric reading is never inflated by that same miner’s coarser label, so a precise 0.57 cannot be rounded up into a payout by the word next to it**」**；**「when nothing usable is present **the signal is `null` and the decision holds** — **it fails closed, never open**」**；**「readings parsed from prose are recorded as **prose-derived**, so **weaker evidence is visible in the on-chain reason instead of silently ranking equal to structured fields**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四條各拒絕一件事**：**① 從任何一種表示法導出；② **明確數字不得被同一個礦工更粗的標籤抬高**——**「一個精確的 0.57 不能被它旁邊的那個詞抬成一次賠付」**；**③ **取不到就置 `null` 並讓決定保持不放款**——**「**it fails closed, never open**」**；**④ **從散文解析出來的讀數被標記為**散文來源**，使**較弱的證據在鏈上理由裡可見，而不是悄悄與結構化字段同級****。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其測試與鏈條逐字**：**「**[79 conformance tests](test-regressions.mjs) pin these guarantees **against captured live responses from every miner shape above, and run in CI on every push**.」**（**實測 `test-regressions.mjs` 存在；⚠️ 未讀其內容、未運行**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **「是什麼、不是什麼」一節把邊界劃得很清楚**：**「It is **not pooled insurance**. **There is no premium, no capital pool and no underwriting** … which makes this **conditional settlement rather than risk transfer**. **Pricing a premium means modelling how likely the event is, which is a different problem from establishing whether it occurred** — and it is the second one this project set out to solve. **The verification layer is the part that has to be trustworthy first; a pool built on a settlement rail nobody trusts would be worth nothing.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **它不是集合保險**（無保費、無資金池、無核保），**而應稱為**附條件的結算**；**② **它把「定價」與「認定事件是否發生」明確分成兩個問題**，並聲明只做第二個；**③ **「先得讓認定層可信」的排序判斷**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其對調度現實的自陳也很少見**——**逐字**：**「**In practice GitHub’s cron scheduler is best-effort, not to-the-minute: observed cadence on this repo has been every 2–5 hours rather than every 15 minutes.** … **the gap is GitHub’s scheduler, not the logic**.」**⭐⭐ **即**把一個「看起來沒按時跑」的現象**歸因到了平台**，**並給出一個鏈上交易作為**真的觸發過**的證據****。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **合約層逐字，且證據被寫進合約調用**：**「A single authorized agent address can trigger a policy’s payout exactly once, and **must attach the full evidence — both signal hashes, both confidence values, a human-readable reason — as part of that call, so the decision is auditable on a block explorer, not just asserted**.」**⭐⭐ **「可核對而不只是被斷言」與第 334 輪 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「報價須由服務端按輸入與規則版本重算」是同一訴求的兩種落點**。**⑪ ⭐ **實測倉庫結構**：**`contracts/StormPolicy.sol` 與 `contracts/StormPolicyBonded.sol`、`build/` 下四個構建產物、`src/decision-engine.mjs`、`study-miner-shapes.mjs`、`study-miner-comparison.mjs`、`study-miner-comparison.json`、`test-regressions.mjs`、`mcp/server.mjs`、`.github/workflows/monitor.yml`、`package.json`**⭐⭐ **三處值得注意**：**① **實測存在**第二個合約 `StormPolicyBonded.sol`**，**而本次所讀的 README 章節只描述了 `StormPolicy.sol`**（**⚠️ 不主張兩者的差異**）；**② **實測存在一份**實測結果數據文件** `study-miner-comparison.json`**；**③ **同一管道另以 **MCP 伺服器**形式暴露**（**`mcp/server.mjs`**）。**⑫ ⭐ 可與 [[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[catrisk-sim]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[floodwise]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[agentbench]] 並讀**。

Neither one alone is enough.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **both signals must each independently find the severity above threshold; neither alone is enough** — **⚠️ and since both signals are two intent categories of the same network** (`WEATHER_FORECAST` and `STORM_ALERT`), **the entry does not claim this constitutes statistically independent sources, only that it requires both to hold at once**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The fourth step separates confidence from correctness and gives the provenance and the specific numbers of that lesson** — **verbatim**: **"It **calibrates confidence**, not just severity: **a forecast miner reporting low confidence in its own data holds the decision regardless of how severe the numbers look.** This is a **direct, deliberate lesson from this project’s own Track 2 WASM-scoring work, where a candidate scored 100% on a rigorous offline adversarial test yet only 7/15 live against the real evaluator** — **stated confidence and real correctness are not the same thing**, and this project does not repeat that mistake by trusting a single self-reported number."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things deserve separate note**: **a rule derived from the project’s own earlier failure — "full marks offline, 7/15 live" is a very concrete and uncommon number for a project to publish about itself**; **and the rule it yields, never again trusting a single self-reported number** — ⭐ **the same family as round 336’s [[inforsight]], with its pre-declared governance band of [0.85, 1.15] for the calibration slope, and round 335’s "rather refuse than pretend"**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The live interception at the fifth step is the most persuasive evidence here, because it was an un-staged real test** — **verbatim**: **"It **binds signals to the policy’s location**, not just to a severity number. **During real testing (not staged) against Jakarta, Indonesia — a location never touched before — the STORM_ALERT miner returned a signal scoped to "South China Sea" rather than Jakarta itself. The entity-binding check caught this live and correctly held instead of releasing a payout on a right-severity, wrong-place signal.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"right severity, wrong place" is a very typical error that looks entirely normal: the number is above threshold, the call succeeded, the fields are present, and the only thing wrong is that the event is not happening here** — ⭐ **and the author states this was real testing, not staged, at a location never touched before**; **⚠️ the record of that test was not verified**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its verdict on failing to parse a field is the sharpest sentence among this round’s four** — **verbatim**: **"Which miner answers is a ranking decision, and ranking is exactly what the flywheel is supposed to change. So the schema an application receives is **a property of the network at call time, not a fixed contract**. **An integration written against one miner’s field names keeps returning HTTP 200 after the router moves on — it simply stops finding the fields it was looking for.** For a consumer that acts on thresholds, **that reads as "conditions are never severe" rather than as a failure, which is the quietest possible way for an automated system to be wrong.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"the quietest possible way for an automated system to be wrong" deserves separate quotation**: **the failure it names raises no exception, returns no non-200 status and times out nowhere — the threshold condition simply never holds**; **and in an automated payout setting, "never fired" and "correctly never fired" look identical in monitoring** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this risk is unique to this protocol — on the contrary, it applies to any automation acting on thresholds read from external fields**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its compatibility measurement is a reproducible small study rather than an impression** — **method verbatim**: **"`study-miner-shapes.mjs` makes real, x402-paid, auto-routed calls for both intents across **12 locations on five continents** … two different consumers … a **canonical-field reader** … versus this project’s **shape-agnostic adapter**."**; **results verbatim**: **"**24 routed calls, 12 locations, $0.24 total, zero failures, median latency 2.0s**"** — **`WEATHER_FORECAST` severity derivable: **canonical-field reader 0/12 (0%)** against **shape-agnostic adapter 12/12 (100%)**; **`STORM_ALERT` likewise 0/12 against 12/12**; **signal bound to the requested place 24/24 (100%)**; **with the reason for the gap given verbatim**: **"Two miners, the same intent, and **exactly one field name in common** (`confidence`). a pool built on a settlement rail nobody trusts would be worth nothing.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **it is not pooled insurance — no premium, no capital pool, no underwriting — and is better described as conditional settlement**; **it separates pricing from establishing whether an event occurred, and declares it solves only the second**; **and it states an ordering judgement that the verification layer must be trustworthy first**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its admission about scheduling reality is also uncommon** — **verbatim**: **"**In practice GitHub’s cron scheduler is best-effort, not to-the-minute: observed cadence on this repo has been every 2–5 hours rather than every 15 minutes.** … **the gap is GitHub’s scheduler, not the logic**."** ⭐⭐ **it attributes an apparent failure to run on time to the platform, and supplies an on-chain transaction as evidence that it really did fire**. **⑩ ⭐⭐ The contract layer is verbatim and the evidence is written into the call**: **"A single authorized agent address can trigger a policy’s payout exactly once, and **must attach the full evidence — both signal hashes, both confidence values, a human-readable reason — as part of that call, so the decision is auditable on a block explorer, not just asserted**."** ⭐⭐ **"auditable rather than merely asserted" lands in the same place as round 334’s [[restaurant-insurance-quote]], where a quote must be recomputed server-side from inputs and rule version**. **⑪ ⭐ Measured repository structure**: **`contracts/StormPolicy.sol` and `contracts/StormPolicyBonded.sol`, four build artefacts under `build/`, `src/decision-engine.mjs`, `study-miner-shapes.mjs`, `study-miner-comparison.mjs`, `study-miner-comparison.json`, `test-regressions.mjs`, `mcp/server.mjs`, `.github/workflows/monitor.yml` and `package.json`** ⭐⭐ **three things to note**: **a second contract, `StormPolicyBonded.sol`, is measurably present while the README sections read here describe only `StormPolicy.sol`** (**⚠️ their difference is not claimed**);
